snippet_primary: "Once I had a small YouTube channel, I invited my viewers to Patreon. I offered: Behind-the-scenes videos, Monthly Q&A sessions, Bonus digital downloads. Result: 45 patrons signed up (most at $3/month). Around $180/month in earnings. But I had to consistently deliver extra content. I realized that Patreon can work — but it demands more ongoing effort."
